passages.text: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land He is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their cities and houses, then you are to set apart for yourselves three cities within the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD your God will destroy the nations.
These nations live in the land that God is giving you.
You will take their land.
You will live in their cities.
You will live in their houses.
God gives you this land to possess.
You must set apart three cities for yourselves in this land.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יַכְרִ֞ית יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֕ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֥ בְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְבָתֵּיהֶֽם׃ שָׁל֥וֹשׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֣יל לָ֑ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: You are to build roads for yourselves and divide into three regions the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that any manslayer can flee to these cities.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God is giving you land as an inheritance.
You must divide this land into three regions.
You must build roads for yourselves in this land.
Any person who kills another person may flee to these cities.
These cities are for the manslayer to escape.
passages.original: תָּכִ֣ין לְךָ֮ הַדֶּרֶךְ֒ וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ גְּב֣וּל אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַנְחִֽילְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֕ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה כָּל־ רֹצֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: Now this is the situation regarding the manslayer who flees to one of these cities to save his life, having killed his neighbor accidentally, without intending to harm him: If he goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut timber and swings his axe to chop down a tree, but the blade flies off the handle and strikes and kills his neighbor, he may flee to one of these cities to save his life.
passages.sermon:
A manslayer is a person who kills another person.
He may kill his neighbor by accident.
He does not hate his neighbor.
He did not plan to harm him.
He and his neighbor may go into the forest together.
They may go to cut wood.
The manslayer swings his axe to cut a tree.
The iron blade comes off the handle.
The blade strikes his neighbor.
His neighbor dies.
The manslayer did not mean to kill.
He may run to one of the special cities.
He may save his life there.
passages.original: וְזֶה֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ יָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וָחָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־ דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמֹ֥ל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃ וַאֲשֶׁר֩ יָבֹ֨א אֶת־ רֵעֵ֥הוּ בַיַּעַר֮ לַחְטֹ֣ב עֵצִים֒ וְנִדְּחָ֨ה יָד֤וֹ בַגַּרְזֶן֙ לִכְרֹ֣ת הָעֵ֔ץ וְנָשַׁ֤ל הַבַּרְזֶל֙ מִן־ הָעֵ֔ץ וּמָצָ֥א אֶת־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת ה֗וּא יָנ֛וּס אֶל־ אַחַ֥ת הֶעָרִים־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה וָחָֽי׃

passages.text: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the manslayer in a rage, overtake him if the distance is great, and strike him dead though he did not deserve to die, since he did not intend any harm.
passages.sermon:
The avenger of blood is a person who seeks to punish a killer.
The avenger of blood might become very angry.
He might chase after the manslayer.
The manslayer is someone who killed another person by accident.
If the road is long, the avenger of blood might catch up to the manslayer.
The avenger of blood might kill the manslayer.
The manslayer does not deserve to die.
The manslayer did not hate the person he killed.
The killing was not done on purpose.
The manslayer did not plan to harm anyone.
passages.original: פֶּן־ יִרְדֹּף֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל הַדָּ֜ם אַחֲרֵ֣י הָרֹצֵ֗חַ כִּי־ יֵחַם֮ לְבָבוֹ֒ וְהִשִּׂיג֛וֹ כִּֽי־ יִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְהִכָּ֣הוּ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְלוֹ֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֔וֶת כִּ֠י לֹ֣א שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

passages.text: This is why I am commanding you to set apart for yourselves three cities.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave them laws to follow.
God wanted to protect innocent people.
God commanded them to set apart three cities.
These cities would be places of safety.
God said, “Set apart three cities for yourselves.”
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֛ן אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁלֹ֥שׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֥יל לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land He promised them, and if you carefully keep all these commandments I am giving you today, loving the LORD your God and walking in His ways at all times, then you are to add three more cities to these three.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD swore to your fathers.
The LORD promised to give your fathers all the land.
If the LORD your God enlarges your territory,
And if He gives you all the land He promised to your fathers,
You must keep all these commandments I am giving you today.
You must love the LORD your God.
You must walk in His ways at all times.
If you do these things,
You must add three more cities to the three cities already set apart.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יַרְחִ֞יב יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ גְּבֻ֣לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְנָ֤תַן לְךָ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לָתֵ֥ת לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃ כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמֹר֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֨ה הַזֹּ֜את לַעֲשֹׂתָ֗הּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּךָ֮ הַיּוֹם֒ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ וְלָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים וְיָסַפְתָּ֨ לְךָ֥ עוֹד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים עַ֖ל הַשָּׁלֹ֥שׁ הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Thus innocent blood will not be shed in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God is giving you land as an inheritance.
This land will belong to you.
You must not allow innocent blood to be shed in your land.
If you prevent the shedding of innocent blood, you will not be guilty of bloodshed.
passages.original: וְלֹ֤א יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֔י בְּקֶ֣רֶב אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ דָּמִֽים׃ס

passages.text: If, however, a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait, attacks him and kills him, and then flees to one of these cities, the elders of his city must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.
passages.sermon:
A man may hate his neighbor.
He may wait in secret for his neighbor.
He may attack his neighbor.
He may kill his neighbor.
He may then run away to one of these cities.
The elders of his city must act.
They must send for the man.
They must take him from the city of refuge.
They must hand him over to the avenger of blood.
The avenger of blood must put him to death.
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ שֹׂנֵ֣א לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְאָ֤רַב לוֹ֙ וְקָ֣ם עָלָ֔יו וְהִכָּ֥הוּ נֶ֖פֶשׁ וָמֵ֑ת וְנָ֕ס אֶל־ אַחַ֖ת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽל׃ וְשָֽׁלְחוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֔וֹ וְלָקְח֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ מִשָּׁ֑ם וְנָתְנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ בְּיַ֛ד גֹּאֵ֥ל הַדָּ֖ם וָמֵֽת׃

passages.text: You must show him no pity. You are to purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, that it may go well with you.
passages.sermon: You must not show pity to the murderer.\r\nYou must remove the guilt of innocent blood from Israel.\r\nIf you do this, things will go well for you.
passages.original: לֹא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵֽינְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֧ דַֽם־ הַנָּקִ֛י מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְט֥וֹב לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
passages.sermon:
God gives you land to possess.
\r\nGod gives this land as your inheritance.
\r\nYour ancestors set boundary markers in this land.
\r\nThese markers show the inheritance for each family.
\r\nYou must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker.
\r\nYou must respect the boundaries set by your ancestors.
passages.original: לֹ֤א תַסִּיג֙ גְּב֣וּל רֵֽעֲךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבְל֖וּ רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים בְּנַחֲלָֽתְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּנְחַ֔ל בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: A lone witness is not sufficient to establish any wrongdoing or sin against a man, regardless of what offense he may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws for justice.
\r\nGod said one witness is not enough.
\r\nOne person alone cannot prove someone did wrong.
\r\nOne person alone cannot prove someone sinned.
\r\nThis rule applies to any offense.
\r\nTwo witnesses must agree to prove a matter.
\r\nThree witnesses can also prove a matter.
\r\nA matter stands only by the word of two or three witnesses.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יָקוּם֩ עֵ֨ד אֶחָ֜ד בְּאִ֗ישׁ לְכָל־ עָוֺן֙ וּלְכָל־ חַטָּ֔את בְּכָל־ חֵ֖טְא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶֽחֱטָ֑א עַל־ פִּ֣י׀ שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל־ פִּ֥י שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־ עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: If a false witness testifies against someone, accusing him of a crime, both parties to the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD, before the priests and judges who are in office at that time.
passages.sermon:
A false witness may accuse a person of a crime.
This means someone lies about another person doing wrong.
Both people in the dispute must stand before the LORD.
They must appear before the priests.
They must also appear before the judges.
These priests and judges serve at that time.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יָק֥וּם עֵד־ חָמָ֖ס בְּאִ֑ישׁ לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּ֖וֹ סָרָֽה׃ וְעָמְד֧וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ לָהֶ֥ם הָרִ֖יב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַשֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְי֖וּ בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵֽם׃

passages.text: The judges shall investigate thoroughly, and if the witness is proven to be a liar who has falsely accused his brother, you must do to him as he intended to do to his brother. So you must purge the evil from among you.
passages.sermon:
The judges must investigate the matter carefully.
A witness may accuse his brother falsely.
If the judges find that the witness lied,
and the witness gave false testimony against his brother,
then you must punish the false witness.
You must do to the false witness what he planned to do to his brother.
In this way, you remove evil from among you.
passages.original: וְדָרְשׁ֥וּ הַשֹּׁפְטִ֖ים הֵיטֵ֑ב וְהִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽד־ שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ הָעֵ֔ד שֶׁ֖קֶר עָנָ֥ה בְאָחִֽיו׃ וַעֲשִׂ֣יתֶם ל֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר זָמַ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לְאָחִ֑יו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then the rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and they will never again do anything so evil among you.
passages.sermon: The people who remain will hear.\r\nThey will become afraid.\r\nThey will not do this evil thing again among you.
passages.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְיִרָ֑אוּ וְלֹֽא־ יֹסִ֨פוּ לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת ע֗וֹד כַּדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: You must show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, and foot for foot.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to Israel through Moses.
God told the people to judge fairly.
God said, “Do not show pity when you judge.”
If someone takes a life, you must take a life in return.
If someone injures an eye, you must injure an eye in return.
If someone breaks a tooth, you must break a tooth in return.
If someone injures a hand, you must injure a hand in return.
If someone injures a foot, you must injure a foot in return.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א תָח֖וֹס עֵינֶ֑ךָ נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּנֶ֗פֶשׁ עַ֤יִן בְּעַ֙יִן֙ שֵׁ֣ן בְּשֵׁ֔ן יָ֥ד בְּיָ֖ד רֶ֥גֶל בְּרָֽגֶל׃ס
